request.description: Create a multiple choice vote poll (requires authentication). Creator can later update title/description but not options.

Get all votes with optional filters (public endpoint - no authentication required). Returns paginated response with total_items, page, page_size, total_pages. Supports filtering by status, type, created_by. Default page_size=20, max=100.
Get active votes with page-based pagination. Returns paginated response with total_items, page, page_size, and total_pages.
Get votes with offset-based pagination. Supports both page/page_size and limit/offset parameters.
Get only single choice votes
Get a specific vote with its options (public endpoint - no authentication required)

Get vote results with vote counts, voter names per option, and user's vote (if authenticated). Results include: vote details, options, vote counts per option, list of voters with names and timestamps for each option, user's current vote, and total votes.
Cast a vote for a single choice poll (requires authentication). If user has already voted, this will update their previous selection. Voting is only allowed when vote status is 'active'.
Cast a vote for a multiple choice poll (requires authentication). If user has already voted, this will update their previous selections. Voting is only allowed when vote status is 'active'.
Get the current user's vote for a specific poll (requires authentication)
Check if the current user has voted on a specific poll (requires authentication)
Update vote title and description (requires authentication, only by creator). Vote options cannot be modified after creation.
Close a vote to prevent further voting (requires authentication, only by creator)
Cancel a vote (requires authentication, only by creator)
Delete a vote (requires authentication, only by creator)
Update the authenticated user's display name (requires authentication)

Create a new team for a vote. Team letter must be 'A' or 'B'. Captain must be one of the voters. Captain is automatically added as the first player. Any logged-in user can create teams (requires authentication).
Get all teams for a vote with player details. Returns array with Team A and Team B (if both exist). Public endpoint - no authentication required.
Get team details including captain info and all players. Public endpoint - no authentication required.
Update team name and/or captain. New captain must be a voter and will be added to the team if not already there. Any logged-in user can update teams (requires authentication).
Delete a team and all its players (cascade delete). Any logged-in user can delete teams (requires authentication).
Get all players in a team with their user details. Public endpoint - no authentication required.
Add a single player to a team. User must have voted in the poll. User cannot be in both teams. Team cannot exceed 20 players. Any logged-in user can add players (requires authentication).
Add multiple players to a team at once. All users must have voted. Users cannot be in both teams. Team cannot exceed 20 players total. Any logged-in user can add players (requires authentication).
Remove a player from a team. Cannot remove the captain - must change captain first. Any logged-in user can remove players (requires authentication).
Fetch only the essential live scorecard information with current score and run rate

body.raw:
{
    "query": "query GetDetailedScorecard($matchId: String!) {
        liveScorecard(match_id: $matchId) {
            match_id
            match_number
            series_name
            team_a
            team_b
            total_overs
            toss_winner
            toss_type
            current_innings
            match_status
            current_score {
                runs
                wickets
                overs
                balls
                run_rate
            }
            current_over {
                over_number
                total_runs
                total_balls
                total_wickets
                status
                balls {
                    ball_number
                    ball_type
                    run_type
                    runs
                    byes
                    is_wicket
                    wicket_type
                }
            }
            innings {
                innings_number
                batting_team
                total_runs
                total_wickets
                total_overs
                total_balls
                status
                extras {
                    byes
                    leg_byes
                    wides
                    no_balls
                    total
                }
                overs {
                    over_number
                    total_runs
                    total_balls
                    total_wickets
                    status
                    balls {
                        ball_number
                        ball_type
                        run_type
                        runs
                        byes
                        is_wicket
                        wicket_type
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }",
    "variables": {
        "matchId": "{{match_id}}"
    }
}
